title: State routing, urgent movers and first-contact SLA

cases.title: A VIC Partner Referral Lead is routed to PR_VIC_TAS
Each state routes to its queue (NSW/ACT, VIC/TAS, QLD, SA/WA/NT) and no state goes to PR_Unassigned
A Lead with move-in inside 48 hours is urgent
Urgent Lead: queue members get a bell notification and the queue email receives a message
Move-in changed into the window makes the Lead urgent and notifies once; out of the window clears it and sends nothing
Scheduled check sends the urgent notification at move-in minus 2 days
SLA Due At is 2 business hours later on the Connectnow Sales calendar (Saturday 19:30 -> Monday 09:30)
A new Lead shows SLA Due At
First move to Working stamps First Contacted At
Later moves to Working keep the first stamp; first contact after SLA Due At sets SLA Breached
The rep's Referral Queue puts urgent Leads first, then by move-in date
200 Leads inserted together get correct routing, urgency and SLA fields
Leads of other record types are not routed, flagged or SLA-stamped
